title: Factory Machines
statement:
Binary-search the minimum whole number of seconds needed for the machines to finish at least T items. A machine with period p finishes an item at times p, 2p, 3p, and so on.

Input
Read n T, followed by n machine periods.

Output
Print the earliest feasible time.

Constraints
1 ≤ n ≤ 200000, 1 ≤ T ≤ 10⁹, and 1 ≤ p ≤ 10⁹.
